title: Machine part of a task report
description: tasks/<id>/library/report.json, written by the task's agent right before `kanban report`, whole each time. Only these keys. pr is required once a PR is open; that is checked by `andon task ready`, not by this schema.

commit.description: HEAD when the report was written.

pr.description: URL of the task's pull request. The gate reads only this.

review_request.description: Present only when asking for a review. The courier starts the reviewer.

limit.description: review_rounds of the task. The courier starts a reviewer only when round <= limit.

commit.description: The commit to review. Must be the PR head.

previous.description: The commit of the previous round; only previous..commit is reviewed again. null on the first round.

extra.description: true for a round beyond the limit; the Chief of Staff decides whether to start it.

waived.description: Findings left unfixed, with the reason.

acceptance.description: Results against the acceptance criteria of the Chief Engineer's document, when there are any.

result.description: fail makes the gate answer fix; manual raises the tier by one.

evidence.description: The test command, or the path of the trace of a use case run.

to.description: person, chief-of-staff, or task (to be cut into a next task).

remember.description: Machine copy of the report's Remember section.

agents_md.description: Machine copy of the report's For AGENTS.md lines.

sha.description: A full git commit id: 40 lowercase hex digits.
